imported_structural_analogue.fact: simultaneous first-order common specialization rescued substitution incompatibilities where literal, alpha, and verified-equality compatibility did not
imported_structural_analogue.use_rule: Treat this only as a rival representation for 0036; do not assume transfer.

hypotheses.H1_SYNCHRONIZED_SPECIALIZATION: 0036 contains target-relevant old/reentry interface pairs that are incompatible under literal matching but admit a simultaneous first-order common specialization.
hypotheses.H2_GENERIC_UNIFICATION: the same rescue rate and target relevance already occur among old-frontier pairs, so reentry is not causal.
hypotheses.H3_WRONG_STATE_OBJECT: common specialization does not selectively rescue target-relevant reentry interfaces; stop refining pairwise equality composition.

decision_table.R1_SYNCHRONIZED_SPECIALIZATION_SIGNAL: reentry-conditioned arm has at least one newly unifiable target-relevant interface and exceeds the old-old control in target-relevant rescue count
decision_table.R2_GENERIC_UNIFICATION_SIGNAL: old-old control has equal or greater target-relevant rescue count
decision_table.R3_NO_SPECIALIZATION_SIGNAL: no newly unifiable target-relevant reentry interface exists

scientific_rule: Diagnostic only. Do not add a substitution proof rule or expose transfer cases until this gate selects R1.
